title: B1: YAML frontmatter parser (replace >> metadata)
description: Hand-roll a small YAML reader (~80 lines) inside CooklangParser.swift and/or Metadata.swift that detects and parses a --- ... --- frontmatter block when it is the first content in the file. Scalar values are stored verbatim under the bare key; list values (indented - items) are joined with ', ' and stored under the bare key. The old >> metadata syntax is dropped entirely — lines starting with >> become plain step text. Read Parser.swift, Scanner.swift, and Metadata.swift before designing the change. No third-party YAML library.
acceptance_criteria: --- frontmatter block detected when it is the first content in the file (blank lines and leading whitespace may precede it)
Scalar YAML values (title: x, servings: 5) stored verbatim as strings under the bare key
YAML list values (key: followed by indented - item lines) joined with ', ' and stored under the bare key
>> lines no longer populate metadata; they are treated as plain step text
Frontmatter --- delimiters do not appear in any step text
No third-party YAML library added to Package.swift
